name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Hihoutou Aratanaru Sangeki
original_name: 金田一少年の事件簿 悲報島 新たなる惨劇
source:
Treasure Isle is rumored to hide a vast bounty of gold said to be guarded by the legendary beast "Yamawara", which Kindaichi and other treasure hunters gather to search for. But the host is killed before the group even arrives, and a bloody slaying takes place during a time in which none of the people on the island could have done it. Will the island's mythical monster-guardian claim more victims?

[from [url=http://psxdata.snesorama.us/games/J/K/SLPS-00601.html]Playstation DataCenter[/url]]
translation:
傳聞秘寶島隱藏著大批黃金，並由傳說中的怪獸「山童」守護。金田一與其他尋寶者為此聚集而來。然而眾人尚未抵達，召集眾人的人便已遭殺害；隨後又發生一場血腥殺戮，而當時島上的任何人似乎都不可能犯案。島上傳說中的怪獸守護者還會奪走更多生命嗎？

[摘自[url=http://psxdata.snesorama.us/games/J/K/SLPS-00601.html]Playstation DataCenter[/url]]
